content:
maria: quick idea — add an optional client header `X-Embed-Latency-Hint-ms` so the ingress/router can honor a max queuing latency and pick a fastpath vs high-efficiency batching. could help low-latency apps.
kevin: interesting. how would that interact with unit/quota billing? low-latency fastpath might increase per-embedding unit cost if we drop batching. need clear accounting. :thinking_face:
zoe: dashboard suggestion: show a new tile with latency_hint distribution, avg batch_size, per-dim p50/p95, and a projected cost delta if a tenant opts into fastpath. would help customers decide.
simon: two quick concerns: 1) abuse — clients can spam low hints to avoid batching and waste capacity; 2) capacity fairness — we should cap fastpath share per-tenant. recommend a `fastpath_tokens_per_min` tenant quota. @security any objections?
maria: nice callouts. propose defaults: header opt-in but ignored unless tenant fastpath quota > 0. router fallback: if load is high, ignore header and fallback to standard batching.
kevin: telemetry changes we need: tag traces with `latency_hint_ms`, `actual_queue_ms`, `route_variant`, `batch_size`, `units_charged`. sample full payload traces at 1% and store aggregated histograms otherwise.
ingest-bot: telemetry event emitted -> embed.request.sample: latency_hint_ms=50, actual_queue_ms=12, batch_size=3, route_variant=fastpath, units=2
zoe: UX: console should let tenants toggle a preview mode — simulate enabling fastpath for 7 days and show estimated cost impact using historical traffic. small CTA to request permanent quota increase.
maria: implementation sketch: 1) ingress parses header and normalizes (cap to 0-2000ms), 2) router heuristic picks path (fastpath if hint < threshold and quota available), 3) quota check + enforcement, 4) telemetry emit + dashboard surfaces. canary plan: 10% traffic next week for internal tenants, 50% week after, full in 3 weeks if metrics look good.
kevin: we'll need SDK docs + curl example. also update billing job to include `fastpath_multiplier` if applicable.
zoe: example curl for docs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Embed-Latency-Hint-ms: 50' \
  -d '{"input": ["short text A","short text B"], "dims":768}'
```
simon: +1. also add a safe-guard: drop header if dims mismatch or dims unknown.
maria: will write a short RFC and link to the canary checklist. thanks all! :rocket:
